version.description: Schema metadata version per ADR-0016. Const v1 = initial baseline.

title: RFC Draft Schema
description: Schema v1 for .rddf/state/.rfc-draft-<proposal_name>.json files. Produced by rfc_interview.sh, consumed by rfc-create --from-draft and approve_proposal.sh --auto-issue.

proposal_name.description: Name of the OpenSpec proposal / improvement file (without .md extension)

stakeholders.description: List of org/repo identifiers expected to review this RFC

gate.description: RDD gate this RFC is associated with

contract_impact.description: Severity classification for the contract change

contract_draft_path.description: Optional path to local contract draft file (base64-inlined into Hub Issue body)

hub_issue_url.description: Populated by rfc-create --from-draft after Hub Issue creation

created_by.description: GitHub username (or RDDF_APPROVE_ACTOR) of the drafter
